title: Automated SCIM provisioning, service-account rotation, and scheduled access reviews
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background:
Redwood needs a reliable, auditable approach to provision and deprovision machine/service accounts across customer tenants, ensure periodic human access certification, and rotate long-lived credentials used by integrations. Existing SCIM onboarding flows handle user lifecycle but do not cover service accounts, automated credential rotation, or the orchestration of quarterly access reviews required for certain regulated customers.

Goal:
Build an end-to-end automation that: 1) extends SCIM and SAML provisioning to discover and tag service accounts; 2) introduces a secure credential rotation pipeline for service account keys/tokens with zero-downtime rotation patterns; 3) wires these controls into the periodic access-review scheduler and evidence/export pipeline so audits have per-tenant proof of rotation and certification; 4) provides console UX for reviewers and ops to approve/override deprovisions.

Success Criteria (measurable):
- 90% of new service accounts are onboarded via SCIM discovery and receive auto-rotation metadata at creation.
- All service account tokens have rotation scheduled within 30 days of creation; 100% rotated at least once every 90 days for P0 customers (policy configurable).
- Access review runbook enumerates service accounts and human owners; reviewers can complete a quarterly review from Console; completion exported to evidence store with signed artifacts.
- End-to-end latency for key rotation < 2 minutes with automated traffic handoff (no 5xx increases).
- Audit export includes rotation events, reviewer decisions, and related PR/issue links for 100% of completed reviews.

Acceptance Criteria / Definition of Done:
- Backend: SCIM provisioning extended to tag service accounts and emit lifecycle events to audit log.
- Rotation pipeline: key-generation, encrypted storage (KMS), rotation handshake with graceful rollout to instances, and immutable rotation record in evidence store.
- Console: reviewer queue view with filters (tenant, severity, last-rotated), one-click certify/revoke, and a visible rotation status per account.
- Export: Evidence artifacts produced in CSV + signed JSON; integration test asserting artifact contents.
- Security review completed and findings closed or tracked.
- Documentation: PRD, runbook, Console help, and one integration example (GitHub Actions + SCIM) in the developer portal.

High-level Implementation Plan / Tasks:
1) Design (API + Data model) - augment SCIM schema to surface service-account metadata and rotation policy reference (ENG / Product review).
2) Provisioning Worker - update provisioning microservice to detect service-account patterns, attach metadata, and emit events.
3) Rotation Service - implement rotation orchestrator (generate new creds via KMS/HSM, handshake with consumer, revoke old creds after confirmation).
4) Access Review Scheduler - integrate service-account entries into quarterly scheduler and reviewer queues.
5) Evidence Export - extend existing evidence pipeline to include rotation logs and reviewer attestations (signed).
6) Console UX - reviewer flow, filters, status badges, and manual rotation trigger.
7) Integration Tests & Load Tests - simulate rotation at scale; ensure throughput and latency targets.
8) Rollout plan and feature flags per-tenant.

Trade-offs and Decisions:
- Option A: Use existing provisioning service vs Option B: new dedicated worker. We chose Option B to limit blast radius and permit independent scaling of rotation flows.
- Rotation cadence default: 90 days vs 30 days for high-compliance customers. Default remains 90 days; policy configurable per-tenant to avoid forcing frequent rotations for low-risk customers.
- Rotation lock-step vs rolling replacement: rolling replacement chosen to maintain availability during rotations.

Risks and Mitigations:
- Consumer integrations break during rotation: mitigate with dual-write handshake and a grace period where both old and new creds accepted for 5 minutes. Monitor error spikes.
- Evidence export size grows significantly: introduce compression and TTL policies for raw logs, with curated signed artifacts retained per compliance SLAs.
- SCIM schema incompatibility with customer IdPs: add opt-in feature toggle and migration tooling.

Monitoring / Metrics / Alerts:
- Metric: rotations_per_minute, rotation_success_rate, rotation_latency_p95. Alert if success_rate < 99.5% for 1h.
- Metric: reviewer_completion_rate_by_cycle. Alert if < 80% three days before cycle deadline for enterprise customers.
- Dashboards: per-tenant rotation coverage, outstanding service-account reviews, and recent rotation error traces.

Rollout Strategy:
- Canary: enable for internal customers only (alpha tenants) behind feature flag for 2 weeks.
- Beta: invite 3 enterprise customers with compliance needs; run in dedicated mode (audit logging enabled) for 4 weeks.
- GA: enable self-serve for all customers with default policies and opt-in controls for strict rotation.

Open Questions / To decide:
- Should rotation events be stored in the same evidence store as human attestation artifacts or a separate immutable ledger?
- Exact UI language for reviewers ("service account" vs "integration key") — design input needed.
- Owner model for service accounts: should ownership be single user, team, or both?
